root_cause_summary: EC2 On-Demand compute spike in us-east-1 driven by unplanned Auto Scaling scale-out in the payments-api service.
likely_drivers: Auto Scaling min capacity increased from 4 to 12 on 2026-04-10 at 02:14 UTC
New c7i.4xlarge instances launched (8 additional instances)
Scale-in policy did not trigger — no traffic reduction detected
suggested_next_action: Review Auto Scaling policy for payments-api. Confirm whether capacity increase was intentional. If not, revert min capacity and investigate trigger.
